findings.evidence: Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/Typeclasses/Probability.lean:111-114 already provides `IsProbabilityMeasure (toNNReal p • μ + toNNReal (σ p) • ν)` for `p : I`, backed by Mathlib/Topology/UnitInterval.lean:576 (`toNNReal_add_toNNReal_symm`); PR occurrences with `hab` are Convex.lean:75, PathSpace/Law/Convex.lean:44, and Correspondence.lean:183,199.
findings.fix: Parameterize the bundled operations and affinity lemmas by `p : unitInterval`, using `unitInterval.toNNReal p` and `unitInterval.toNNReal (unitInterval.symm p)` as coefficients; retain `ExchangeableLaw.smul_add_smul` as the general unbundled closure lemma.
findings.issue: `convexCombo` requires two `ℝ≥0∞` weights plus `hab : a + b = 1`; the same unnecessary normalization argument propagates through `exchangeableLawConvexCombo` and both de Finetti affinity theorems.

summary: The bundled convex API uses a nonstandard, proof-heavy parameterization instead of Mathlib’s canonical unit-interval parameterization.
